id.description: unique, kebab-case; the depends_on reference key

description.description: one human line shown in the TUI

type.description: selects the provider; must be a registered type (validated by the loader)

requires.description: host capabilities the entry needs (subset semantics); enum kept in sync with core/environment.py KNOWN_CAPABILITIES

name.description: deb: file basename under keyrings/sources.list.d/preferences.d (default: entry id); apt silently ignores other characters

key_url.description: deb repo mode: the signing key URL (https only — this is the trust root)

repo_url.description: deb repo mode: the repository URI (deb822 URIs field)

suite.description: deb repo mode: deb822 Suites; may embed {codename} (resolved from /etc/os-release); '/' or a path ending in '/' for flat repos

components.description: deb repo mode: deb822 Components; omit entirely for flat repos

architectures.description: deb repo mode: deb822 Architectures (default: the host's dpkg --print-architecture)

pin.description: deb repo mode: an apt preferences pin written to /etc/apt/preferences.d/<name> (the Firefox official-repo case)

deb_url.description: deb direct mode: a remote .deb installed via apt-get install <file> (requires 'package' for the idempotency check)

check.description: script: the idempotency probe command (bash -o pipefail -c). REQUIRED for script entries; must be a real probe (absolute paths, never login-shell PATH) — a vacuous probe is rejected in review

install.description: script: the official install command, recorded verbatim (bash -o pipefail -c)

remove.description: script: reserved (the remove op is deferred in this MVP slice)

upgrade.description: script: reserved (the upgrade op is deferred in this MVP slice)

sudo.description: script: explicit privilege declaration — true escalates the command per-command via the runner's sudo variant; default is the plain user (user-level installs into $HOME)

allOf.$comment: apt requires a package name (field set kept in sync with apt.py and authoring-guidelines.md)

deb has two mutually exclusive modes (kept in sync with deb.py and authoring-guidelines.md): repo mode (third-party APT repository: deb822 + keyring) or direct mode (a remote .deb). Supply the fields for exactly one mode.
script requires an explicit idempotency probe and the official install command (kept in sync with script.py and authoring-guidelines.md); remove/upgrade/sudo are optional
